message.description: Message returned/logged on block; supports {checks} placeholder.

scan_tool_results.description: Also scan tool.result output via before:tool.result. Default false.

scan_llm_responses.description: Also scan raw model output via before:llm.response, before the agent loop consumes it. In block mode the substituted response carries no tool calls. Default false.

scan_stream.description: Also scan each text delta via before:llm.stream.chunk, before it is released, so flagged text under streaming is never shown rather than retracted afterwards. Defaults to scan_llm_responses; without it the engine turns streaming off for this plugin (core.streaming.response_gate_policy).

stream_hold_back.description: Minimum trailing bytes of each candidate release to withhold, on top of the always-on trailing-token rule. Only needed for a custom_patterns entry that spans whitespace. Costs that many bytes of streaming lag. Default 0.

custom_patterns.description: Additional regular expressions; each match treated as a violation.
